scope: Bounded Push action-path curvature, fit-withheld causal interchange, actual-past contexts and cached followup diagnostics

owned_gpu_stages.accounting: Measured stage wall times, excludes loading, earlier failed startup and independent physical/reference collector jobs; not a utilization-integrated GPU billing measure

findings.curvature: Full-spatial action-response paths bend. Curved interpolation improves internal causal interchange fidelity beyond endpoint-line reparameterization; not evidence of useful policy steering.
findings.real_history: Actual past context improves encoded-image prediction but increases path bending. Real rendered+encoded image paths are substantially more bent than physical XY paths.
findings.native_hybrid: At P3/H3 radius4, actual encoded-future MSE native hybrid .155309, donor import .155209, cubic .154301. Cubic is worse than near-chord on 3/4 initial states, so its mean advantage is not a robust local-linear win.
findings.native_error: Donor-import/native-hybrid disagreement MSE at P3/H3 is 2.00e-6/3.55e-5 for radii1/4, far below corresponding physical prediction error .159/.155.
findings.action_consistency: At radius1 H6, actual-past conditioning improves overall image error but slightly worsens action-effect error; visual-only planner ranking remains unreliable.
findings.recommendation: No residual candidate is promoted to the larger held-out steering study by these diagnostics.

limitations: Four source states; directions, radii, fit-withheld targets and horizons are correlated.
Radius4 interior ±.25 reuses previously sampled radius1 endpoints; withheld per curve fit, not globally unseen.
Actual donor and actual past contexts are privileged diagnostics; no new edited policy execution.
Partial donor P3 residual import leaves some central context and action conditioning intact.
Visual-only goal costs omit unavailable predicted proprio and are not full native planner costs.
One physical source has zero block endpoint motion in many views; undefined curvature ratios are flagged, not assigned zero or counted as four valid groups.
Angle unit-circle embedding can itself bend; no mixing angle and pixel units.
Curvature is sampled response geometry, not proof of a semantic manifold, density, safety or useful control.
